_comment: Authored analysis: ownership, lifecycle, refcount and locking judgements that no composer can derive, keyed to the C entities they describe. The structural half of each record (field layout, signatures, footprints, casts) is composed from the CodeQL tables on demand and merged in at read time, so a re-extract rewrites nothing here. Written only by `wavefront <repo> <target> query {types,symbols} --update`; read through wavefront.manifests. Hand-edit at your own risk: `--update` validates a submission against the composed skeleton (unknown field, wrong kind, ptr-invariant violation) and this file does not.

types.name: AVAES
types._comment_agent: Public forward declaration only. av_aes_alloc allocates aligned, zeroed private storage; av_aes_init copies 16/24/32 bytes into the inline round schedule. state is scratch, rounds/crypt select dispatch. No retained key or other resource. Invalid key bits alter rounds/crypt before returning EINVAL, so validate before safe reinitialization. Every observed holder exclusively accesses its context and frees it with av_free/av_freep. No clone API; no Send/Sync asserted.

ptr.note: av_aes_alloc zeroes crypt (construction only); av_aes_init and ff_init_aes_x86 replace it with process-lifetime C/assembly functions. No ownership or captured caller data. Initialized contexts have a non-null crypt function. Internal, not published in aes.h.

types.name: AVAESCTR
types._comment_agent: Public forward declaration only. Counter[16], encrypted_counter[16], block_offset and inline AVAES, no owned/borrowed pointer fields. av_aes_ctr_alloc uses av_mallocz; init copies key, initializes embedded AES, resets counter/offset; av_aes_ctr_free calls av_free without reading storage. get_iv returns a borrowed pointer into counter, invalidated by free and changed by crypt/setters/reinit. No clone API. C never retains caller key, IV or processing buffers.

types.name: AVActiveFormatDescription
types._comment_agent: C enum (SAME=8, 4_3=9, 16_9=10, 14_9=11, 4_3_SP_14_9=13, 16_9_SP_14_9=14, SP_4_3=15), no fields, no lifecycle; every enumerator is non-negative so bindgen backs ffi::AVActiveFormatDescription by c_uint. No C signature takes or returns the enum: its values travel as the single byte of AV_FRAME_DATA_AFD / AV_PKT_DATA_AFD side data (mpeg12dec writes the parsed afd byte, itut35.c writes payload & 0xf, v210enc copies the frame side data into the packet, ffprobe/vf_showinfo print data[0] as an integer). The value set is therefore open: the reserved 4-bit codes 0-7 and 12, and any other byte, reach readers. Wrapped as a transparent newtype accepting every bit pattern, with byte conversions for the side-data payload.

types.name: AVAlphaMode
types._comment_agent: C enum (c_uint under bindgen), no fields, no lifecycle. Open value set: AVFrame.alpha_mode is a public field C users write directly, frame.c copies it verbatim, and av_alpha_mode_from_name returns AVERROR(EINVAL) (-22, i.e. 0xffffffea as c_uint) typed as enum AVAlphaMode; av_alpha_mode_name maps (unsigned)mode >= AVALPHA_MODE_NB to NULL. AVALPHA_MODE_NB is 'Not part of ABI'. Zero (UNSPECIFIED) is the zeroed and get_frame_defaults value. Wrapped as a transparent newtype accepting every bit pattern.

types.name: AVBPrint
types._comment_agent: AVBPrint (FF_PAD_STRUCTURE, 1024 bytes) is caller storage initialised in place by av_bprint_init / av_bprint_init_for_buffer and torn down by av_bprint_finalize (a disposer: frees str when allocated, keeps the struct). Rust holds it behind an av_malloc block (str may point into the struct): BPrintBox = CBox<BPrint, BPrintFinalize> (finalize(NULL) + av_free) for av_bprint_init, and CBox<BPrint, BufferStorage<'b>> (av_free only, borrowing the caller buffer) for av_bprint_init_for_buffer. len/size/size_max are maintained by bprint.c; external writers only shrink len and re-terminate (avcodec.c) or commit av_bprint_get_buffer writes (pngdec.c).

ptr.note: The string buffer, NUL-terminated at min(len, size - 1) whenever size > 0, possibly holding binary data before that. Runtime-conditional ownership: it points at reserved_internal_buffer (av_bprint_init, automatic storage reaching through reserved_padding to the end of the 1024-byte struct; also the size-0 fallback of av_bprint_init_for_buffer), at an av_realloc block the struct owns once av_bprint_alloc grew it (av_bprint_is_allocated: str != reserved_internal_buffer; released by av_bprint_finalize(buf, NULL) or handed out by av_bprint_finalize(buf, &s)), or at a caller buffer from av_bprint_init_for_buffer (borrowed from `other`; is_allocated is then true too, but size == size_max keeps av_bprint_alloc from reallocating it, and finalize must never run on it). NULL after av_bprint_finalize either hands the allocation out or releases it with av_freep when ret_str is NULL; inline storage is not cleared by finalization. Self-referential in the inline case, so an initialised AVBPrint must not move.

types.name: AVBlowfish
types._comment_agent: p is u32[18], s is u32[4][256] (nested dimension omitted in structural oracle array record). No pointers/resources, address identity, field disposal, or C clone. av_blowfish_alloc uses av_mallocz; av_free releases it. av_blowfish_init also fills stack contexts (rtmpe9_sig) and retains neither context nor key. Public arrays support copying getters and replacement setters.

types.name: AVBuffer
types._comment_agent: Opaque in the public API (buffer.h forward-declares it; the body is in buffer_internal.h): callers only hold AVBuffer through AVBufferRef.buffer, and may compare two of those pointers to tell whether two references share one data buffer (buffer.h's own guidance; av_buffer_replace does it). No public routine takes an AVBuffer: it is created with one reference by av_buffer_create (av_mallocz'd body, or via av_buffer_alloc/allocz/realloc) or by av_buffer_pool_get (pool_alloc_buffer re-targets the allocator's AVBuffer at pool_release_buffer; a recycled entry reuses the AVBuffer embedded in its BufferPoolEntry with BUFFER_FLAG_NO_FREE), gains references with av_buffer_ref/replace (relaxed atomic add) and is released by buffer_replace when av_buffer_unref/make_writable/realloc/replace drops the last reference (acq_rel atomic sub): free(opaque, data), then av_free of the body unless NO_FREE. No clone of the body (av_buffer_make_writable copies the data into a new buffer). Shared state is race-free for concurrent readers: refcount is atomic; data/size/free/opaque/flags are written only before the first reference is published (buffer_create, pool_alloc_buffer, av_buffer_pool_get under the pool lock) or by av_buffer_realloc on a writable reference, i.e. the only one. Rust (buffer-frame wave 0 batch 1): define_ctype!(Buffer) with no field accessors and no owner (AVBufferRef's wrapper owns references); Buffer is Sync (handles are shareable), Send withheld until the constructors that install data release callbacks prove them thread-agnostic.

ptr.note: The size-byte data array, released by the buffer's own free(opaque, data) callback when the last reference goes (av_buffer_default_free = av_free for av_buffer_alloc/allocz/realloc storage; any caller routine for av_buffer_create). NULL is accepted by av_buffer_create (only free and the copies in make_writable/realloc with size bytes ever touch it). Written by buffer_create and by av_buffer_realloc's in-place av_realloc (REALLOCATABLE buffers, writable reference only, which also rewrites AVBufferRef.data). For pool buffers the pool keeps its own copy in BufferPoolEntry.data and frees it at flush through the allocator's original free. AVBufferRef.data may point anywhere inside it.

Data release callback, never NULL (buffer_create substitutes av_buffer_default_free); called once by buffer_replace on the thread that drops the last reference, before av_free of the body. pool_alloc_buffer swaps it for pool_release_buffer (the original moves into the BufferPoolEntry).

Type-erased cookie handed back to free(opaque, data) and returned by av_buffer_get_opaque; buffer.c never dereferences it, so its release is whatever free does. pool_alloc_buffer replaces it with the BufferPoolEntry (which outlives the AVBuffer and keeps the allocator's original opaque, read back by av_buffer_pool_buffer_get_opaque); av_buffer_pool_get sets it to the entry for recycled buffers.

types.name: AVBufferPool
types._comment_agent: Opaque in the public API. Constructed by av_buffer_pool_init(size, alloc) and av_buffer_pool_init2(size, opaque, alloc2, pool_free) (av_mallocz + ff_mutex_init, refcount 1 = the caller's reference; NULL on failure, in which case init2 never calls pool_free). The caller's reference is released by av_buffer_pool_uninit(&pool) (flushes free entries under the mutex, NULLs the slot, acq_rel decrement); every outstanding buffer from av_buffer_pool_get holds one more reference (relaxed increment), returned by pool_release_buffer, so the pool body, the mutex and the user opaque outlive the caller's handle until the last buffer comes back, then buffer_pool_free flushes, destroys the mutex, calls pool_free(opaque) and frees the body. There is no public up-ref or clone, so the caller's handle is a sole owner. Thread-safe by construction: the free-entry list is touched only under the mutex, refcount is atomic, size/alloc/alloc2/opaque/pool_free are written only by init before the pool is published; alloc/alloc2 run under the mutex (serialized, any thread), pool_free on whichever thread releases last. Rust (buffer-frame wave 0 batch 1): define_ctype!(BufferPool), Send + Sync, BufferPoolBox = CBox<BufferPool, BufferPoolUninit> (av_buffer_pool_uninit on a local slot), BufferPool::new = av_buffer_pool_init(size, NULL), unsafe BufferPool::with_allocator = av_buffer_pool_init2 with a boxed Rust FnMut + Send state as opaque and its drop as pool_free.

ptr.note: av_buffer_pool_init's allocator, or av_buffer_alloc when NULL; init2 stores av_buffer_alloc as the fallback. Called by pool_alloc_buffer under the pool mutex with pool->size when alloc2 is NULL; its result must be a sole, writable reference whose AVBuffer data holds at least size bytes (recycled references reuse buffer->data with pool->size). The result's AVBuffer keeps its own free(opaque, data) callback in the BufferPoolEntry, and buffer_pool_flush calls it when the entry is flushed: under the pool mutex from av_buffer_pool_uninit, and unlocked from buffer_pool_free as the pool is freed; that callback must therefore not lock the pool either (no av_buffer_pool_get, no release of the last reference to one of its buffers, no av_buffer_pool_uninit), or the default, non-recursive mutex is locked twice on one thread.

av_buffer_pool_init2's allocator (NULL selects alloc = av_buffer_alloc); takes precedence over alloc. Called by pool_alloc_buffer under the pool mutex with (opaque, pool->size), with the same result contract as alloc. The result's AVBuffer keeps its own free(opaque, data) callback in the BufferPoolEntry, and buffer_pool_flush calls it when the entry is flushed: under the pool mutex from av_buffer_pool_uninit, and unlocked from buffer_pool_free as the pool is freed; that callback must therefore not lock the pool either (no av_buffer_pool_get, no release of the last reference to one of its buffers, no av_buffer_pool_uninit), or the default, non-recursive mutex is locked twice on one thread.

init2's user state, passed to every alloc2 call and released by pool_free(opaque) in buffer_pool_free when pool_free is non-NULL (owned); with no pool_free the caller keeps it alive at least until the pool is freed, which may be after av_buffer_pool_uninit returns (borrowed, other). NULL for av_buffer_pool_init pools. Never dereferenced by buffer.c.

Head of the singly linked list (via BufferPoolEntry.next) of free entries, each av_mallocz'd by pool_alloc_buffer and pushed back by pool_release_buffer when its buffer's last reference goes. Popped by av_buffer_pool_get (entry reused with its embedded AVBuffer), and freed by buffer_pool_flush (entry->free(entry->opaque, entry->data), then av_freep(entry)) from av_buffer_pool_uninit and buffer_pool_free. Entries handed out are owned by their AVBuffer's references until returned. NULL when no free entry exists.
init2's opaque releaser, called once by buffer_pool_free after the flush and mutex destruction, just before the pool body is freed; never called when init2 fails. NULL for av_buffer_pool_init pools.

types.name: AVBufferRef
types._comment_agent: One reference to an AVBuffer: a 24-byte struct the caller owns outright, holding one counted reference to the shared buffer plus a window (data, size) into the buffer's bytes. buffer.h says its size is not public ABI and it is never allocated directly: every instance comes from av_mallocz in buffer_create (av_buffer_create, and through it av_buffer_alloc/allocz/realloc(NULL)), av_buffer_ref (copies *buf into a fresh struct and does a relaxed atomic add on buffer->refcount) or av_buffer_pool_get (pool_alloc_buffer / a recycled entry). It is released by av_buffer_unref(&ref) -> buffer_replace: av_freep of the struct, acq_rel decrement of buffer->refcount, and on the last one buffer->free(opaque, data) and av_free of the AVBuffer body unless BUFFER_FLAG_NO_FREE (pool entries). av_buffer_make_writable/av_buffer_realloc/av_buffer_replace replace a reference in place (same slot, new struct). No field stores the reference count: it lives in AVBuffer.refcount (atomic_uint, 32-bit, unchecked: each av_buffer_ref adds one). Writability convention: the bytes may be written only while av_buffer_is_writable (refcount == 1 and not AV_BUFFER_FLAG_READONLY); C writes AVBuffer data in place only through av_buffer_realloc on a writable reference. Bytes from av_buffer_alloc and pool buffers are uninitialised; av_buffer_allocz zeroes them; av_buffer_create takes the caller's bytes as they are. Thread safety: buffer.h documents referencing/unreferencing as thread-safe; the struct itself is plain data owned by one holder, and shared readers only read it. Rust (buffer-frame wave 1 batch 0): define_ctype!(BufferReference) (the BufferRef/BufferMut names belong to AVBuffer's handles), BufferReferenceBox = CBox<BufferReference, BufferUnref> with av_buffer_unref on a local slot as c_drop and av_buffer_ref as c_dup (new struct, shared AVBuffer), which refuses once the 32-bit count reaches u32::MAX/2 so leaked clones cannot wrap it; constructors alloc (av_buffer_alloc -> UninitBuffer, a hand-written owner of uninitialised bytes), alloc_zeroed (av_buffer_allocz), from_heap_vec (av_buffer_create with the default free), from_owner/from_read_only (av_buffer_create with a Rust Box<T> as opaque, dropped by the free trampoline); getters data/len/buffer/try_clone on BufferReferenceRef, data_mut (writable only), advance/truncate (narrowing) and replace/set (whole-reference swap) on BufferReferenceMut.

ptr.note: One counted reference to the shared AVBuffer body (the count is AVBuffer.refcount, not a field here). Set by buffer_create / copied by av_buffer_ref (with a relaxed atomic increment) / set by av_buffer_pool_get; released by buffer_replace on unref. Never NULL in a live reference (buffer_replace dereferences it unconditionally). The body is only read through it by av_buffer_is_writable/get_ref_count/get_opaque/pool_buffer_get_opaque/realloc and compared for identity (av_buffer_replace, h264 refs). Mutable: av_buffer_realloc writes buffer->data/size in place on a writable reference, and the count is written atomically by every ref/unref. Rust: BufferReferenceRef::buffer() lends a BufferRef handle for identity; the field is replaced only together with data/size, by swapping whole references (BufferReferenceMut::replace/set), and copied as a new counted reference by try_clone/Clone.

Start of this reference's window into the buffer's bytes: size bytes inside [buffer->data, buffer->data + buffer->size). Borrowed from the AVBuffer the `buffer` field keeps alive (the AVBuffer's free callback owns the bytes). Two references to one buffer may describe different windows (callers advance data / shrink size themselves, e.g. packet parsers); av_buffer_replace re-syncs data/size from src. Writable only while the reference is the sole one and not READONLY (av_buffer_is_writable); av_buffer_realloc rewrites data in place. May be NULL when av_buffer_create was given NULL with size 0. Bytes may be uninitialised (av_buffer_alloc, pool buffers, realloc growth). Rust: &[u8] through BufferReferenceRef::data (initialised invariant on every BufferReferenceBox), Option<&mut [u8]> through data_mut (writable check), &mut [MaybeUninit<u8>] through UninitBuffer; narrowed only (advance), never widened, as the buffer's bounds are private.

types.name: AVCAMELLIA
types._comment_agent: Opaque in public header; concrete body has only Kw[4], Ke[6], K[24] u64 arrays and key_bits int. av_camellia_alloc allocates full av_mallocz storage, freed by av_free, no nested allocations/copy/dispose primitives. init reads exactly 16/24/32 key bytes, stores schedule not pointer. computeSP unconditionally rewrites static SP on every init; all safe init and future crypt operations must share a Rust global lock, even on distinct contexts. Raw C accesses must exclude races.

types.name: AVCAST5
types._comment_agent: Opaque in cast5.h. Concrete private body contains two 17-element u32 arrays and rounds, no pointer fields or resources. av_cast5_alloc returns fresh av_mallocz storage, released by av_free; av_cast5_init copies a 5..16-byte key, sets rounds=12 or 16 and writes keys in place. C crypt routines only read context. No C clone/dispose/refcount and no retained buffers. Public fields: none. Consumers in libavutil/tests/cast5.c free with av_free; tools/crypto_bench.c retains a process-lifetime static allocation.

types.name: AVCIExy
types._comment_agent: Plain by-value pair of AVRational (x, y): the CIE 1931 chromaticity coordinates; no pointer fields, no heap lifecycle. Also spelled AVWhitepointCoefficients (typedef). C never allocates, frees, clones or constructs one on its own: it lives embedded by value as AVPrimaryCoefficients.r/g/b and AVColorPrimariesDesc.wp, in csp.c's static const color_primaries table (handed out as a const pointer by av_csp_primaries_desc_from_id, read field by field by av_csp_primaries_id_from_desc), and is passed and copied by value by its other readers and writers (swscale csputils cie_X/cie_Z/test_point_line, ff_cie_xy_equal; dovi_rpudec get_cie_xy returns one by value; fflcms2 XYZ_xy writes through an out pointer; pngdec/pngenc, vf_colorspace, colorspace.c read the fields). No coordinate is range-checked: C's table holds fractions such as 3127/10000, unspecified primaries are all-zero (0/0 coordinates, skipped by av_csp_primaries_id_from_desc on r.x.num == 0), and decoders store whatever the bitstream carries, so all-zero is a valid value. Wrapped as the ffibox layout type CieXy (CZeroable, Copy, Send + Sync as plain data) with CieXyRef x/y getters returning RationalRef handles over the projected places, and CieXyMut x_mut/y_mut handles plus set_x/set_y/set.

types.name: AVCRCId
types._comment_agent: Resource-free scalar enum. All eight public polynomial encodings preserved, AV_CRC_MAX is a private sentinel, unknown encodings preserved. av_crc_get_table bounds-checks before indexing and returns immutable static storage (17-entry arch-specific data or 257/1024-entry ordinary tables); no fixed-length slice can be assumed.

types.name: AVChannel
types._comment_agent: C enum (c_int under bindgen, AV_CHAN_NONE = -1), no fields, no lifecycle. Open value set: AVChannelCustom.id is a public field; av_channel_from_string returns any non-negative strtol result for 'USR<n>' and AMBISONIC_BASE + n for 'AMBI<n>' (n in 0..=1023); av_channel_name/description name every int (AMBI%d, NONE, UNK, UNSD, USR%d). Ambisonic ACN index = id - AV_CHAN_AMBISONIC_BASE over AMBISONIC_BASE..=AMBISONIC_END. Native-order mask bit is 1ULL << id for id < 64. Wrapped as a transparent newtype accepting every bit pattern.

types.name: AVChannelCustom
types._comment_agent: formats wave-1 batch-1 (wrap): by-value POD element of the custom-order AVChannelLayout.u.map array; no lifecycle routine of its own. The array is allocated by av_channel_layout_custom_init / av_channel_layout_from_string / av_channel_layout_retype (av_calloc / av_malloc_array), copied by av_channel_layout_copy (av_malloc_array + memcpy) and freed by av_channel_layout_uninit (av_freep), all AVChannelLayout lifecycle owned by the wave-2 type. sizeof(AVChannelCustom) is public ABI (32 bytes). name is char[16], written by av_strlcpy (always NUL-terminated by C writers) and read with strcmp/%s/name[0]; a raw writer could leave it unterminated, so the Rust getter copies the 16 bytes and stops at 16. id is any int (AV_CHAN_UNKNOWN default from custom_init, user ids from USR<n>). All-zero is valid (C's own `AVChannelCustom custom = {0}`).

ptr.note: User cookie. No FFmpeg code reads, writes through or frees it (field-touchers: none tree-wide); av_channel_layout_from_string/custom_init leave it NULL (zeroed {0} / av_calloc), av_channel_layout_copy duplicates the map with memcpy so the address is shallow-copied into the new map, and av_channel_layout_uninit frees the map without touching it. Its pointee type, cardinality and lifetime are the user's alone (recorded as scalar/other for want of a vocabulary for 'never dereferenced'); mutable undeterminable because FFmpeg never dereferences it. Wrapped as a raw *mut c_void getter/setter that are safe: storing or reading the address dereferences nothing.

types.name: AVChannelLayout
types._comment_agent: formats wave-2 batch-0 (wrap): by-value struct whose sizeof is public ABI, embedded in AVFrame, AVCodecContext, AVCodecParameters etc. and allocated on the stack by C users; not address-sensitive (C copies it by assignment, e.g. `*channel_layout = channel_layout_map[i].layout`). It owns resources only in CUSTOM order (u.map). Lifecycle: disposer av_channel_layout_uninit (frees a CUSTOM map, zeroes all fields, opaque included); deep cloner av_channel_layout_copy (uninits dst first; on ENOMEM leaves dst CUSTOM with a NULL map, an invalid state); constructors/initialisers av_channel_layout_custom_init, av_channel_layout_from_mask, av_channel_layout_from_string and av_channel_layout_default (from_mask and default overwrite fields without uninit and leak a prior CUSTOM map, so the wrapper only runs them on a fresh zeroed value). All-zero is valid (UNSPEC, 0 channels, documented `{0}` init) and accepted by uninit. Assigning one layout to another duplicates map ownership (forbidden by the header), so the Rust layout type is neither Copy nor Clone and has no safe from_raw. C readers assume CUSTOM => map holds nb_channels elements with NUL-terminated names (strcmp, %s), and compute nb_channels - popcount(mask) for AMBISONIC (signed overflow for nb_channels near INT_MIN). Wrapped as ChannelLayout (layout) + ChannelLayoutVal = CVal<ChannelLayout, ChannelLayoutUninit>, with a tagged enum over order/u.

ptr.note: User cookie. No FFmpeg code dereferences or frees it: av_channel_layout_retype (its only toucher tree-wide) saves and restores it across the uninit it performs, av_channel_layout_copy shallow-copies the address with `*dst = *src`, and av_channel_layout_uninit zeroes it with the rest of the struct. Its pointee type, cardinality and lifetime are the user's alone (recorded as scalar/other for want of a 'never dereferenced' vocabulary). Wrapped, as AVChannelCustom.opaque is, as a raw *mut c_void getter and setter that are safe: storing or reading the address dereferences nothing.

Union member, valid only when order == AV_CHANNEL_ORDER_CUSTOM (u.mask otherwise). An av_malloc-family block of at least nb_channels initialised AVChannelCustom the layout owns: allocated by av_channel_layout_custom_init (av_calloc, exactly nb_channels), av_channel_layout_from_string (av_dynarray2_add, capacity may exceed nb_channels; av_calloc in the ambisonic path), av_channel_layout_copy (av_malloc_array + memcpy, deep copy) and av_channel_layout_retype (custom_init), and by user code (libavfilter/af_channelsplit.c av_mallocz); freed only by av_channel_layout_uninit (av_freep, CUSTOM order only). Elements are written in place by C (ids, av_strlcpy names). The one borrowed use is try_describe_ambisonic's local `extra` (map + offset), which never escapes and is never uninitialised. NULL arises only from a failed av_channel_layout_copy (CUSTOM order, nb_channels > 0, map NULL), which C readers would dereference; the wrapper resets the layout on that failure and guards copies of such a source.

types.name: AVChannelOrder
types._comment_agent: C enum (unsigned underlying type, values 0..=3 named; FF_CHANNEL_ORDER_NB is not part of ABI/API). No pointers, no lifecycle: a plain value. Stored in the public field AVChannelLayout.order, which users write directly (and C compound-literal macros AV_CHANNEL_LAYOUT_* initialise), and passed by value to av_channel_layout_retype; av_channel_layout_check/compare/describe switch on it with a default arm, so any value can reach C storage. The Rust wrapper must therefore be an open, layout-compatible newtype accepting every value, plain-data (CPlainElem), Send+Sync as an integer.

types.name: AVChromaLocation
types._comment_agent: C enum (unsigned underlying type, values 0..=6 named; AVCHROMA_LOC_NB is not part of ABI). No pointers, no lifecycle: a plain value. Stored in public fields users write directly (AVFrame.chroma_location, AVCodecParameters.chroma_location, AVCodecContext.chroma_sample_location) and taken by value by av_chroma_location_name / av_chroma_location_enum_to_pos, which range-check it ((unsigned)location < AVCHROMA_LOC_NB), so any value can reach C storage. The Rust wrapper must be an open, layout-compatible newtype accepting every value, plain-data (CPlainElem), Send+Sync as an integer.

types.name: AVClass
types._comment_agent: Review core wave-1 batch-0: published library classes and child_class_iterate results are immutable static descriptors; no class-specific allocator, disposer, or cloner exists. Exception to the previous whole-tree static-only claim: libavfilter/vidstabutils.c:vs2av_log initializes an automatic AVClass with a borrowed caller tag and passes its address through a stack context to synchronous av_vlog. ClassRef must carry the actual descriptor and pointee lifetime. Class::new is Rust-owned immutable storage (local or static); its name is static. No lifecycle representation is missing.

ptr.note: Iterates the static classes of potential children through an opaque void* state the caller initializes to NULL; returns NULL at the end. Called by av_opt_child_class_iterate and av_opt_find2's FAKE_OBJ child search; every in-tree iterator returns pointers to static const AVClass objects (iamf.c, options.c, avfilter.c...).
Returns the next AVOptions-enabled child object of an existing object after prev (NULL starts), or NULL; the child is borrowed from the object. Called by av_opt_child_next.

Usually a static literal in an immutable static class. Exception: libavfilter/vidstabutils.c:vs2av_log builds a stack-local class with class_name = tag borrowed from its caller, valid only during synchronous av_vlog. ClassRef and its string view must be bounded by the actual class/name lifetime, not assumed static. The wrapper accepts NULL names.

Per-instance category callback, preferred by log.c get_category() over the category field (version >= 51.56 gate) and by ffprobe's log callback; takes the object as void* and returns an AVClassCategory by value.

Callback returning the name of an object of the class; called by log.c item_name() (falling back to av_default_item_name when NULL), fftools and tee.c. Takes the AVClass-enabled object as void* and returns a string the object or class keeps alive; never written after the static initializer.

The class's option table: a static const AVOption array terminated by an entry with a NULL name (av_opt_next stops there), or NULL for a class without options. Never allocated, written or freed by any C path; the safe getter scans to the terminator and returns a CSlice of OptionDef handles borrowed for the class's lifetime.

Range query callback with av_opt_query_ranges' signature: on success it stores a fresh av_malloc'd AVOptionRanges (released by av_opt_freep_ranges) in its out slot and returns the component count, which av_opt_query_ranges stores in nb_components. No in-tree class sets it; av_opt_query_ranges falls back to av_opt_query_ranges_default.

types.name: AVClassCategory
types._comment_agent: Field-less enum with no lifecycle: a plain unsigned value (bindgen c_uint). C stores it by value in AVClass.category and returns it from AVClass.get_category / av_default_get_category, unchecked, so any unsigned value can reach Rust (log.c get_category guards >= AV_CLASS_CATEGORY_NB). AV_CLASS_CATEGORY_NB is documented as not part of ABI/API. Wrapped as an open Copy newtype, not a closed Rust enum.

types.name: AVClassStateFlags
types._comment_agent: Field-less bit-flag enum with no lifecycle. Never stored as the enum type: callers combine AV_CLASS_STATE_INITIALIZED into an unsigned state_flags member (FFBitStreamFilterContext, FFFilterContext) located through AVClass.state_flags_offset; opt.c reads it to reject non-runtime options on initialized objects. Any unsigned bit pattern is valid. Wrapped as a Copy bit-set newtype.

types.name: AVColorPrimaries
types._comment_agent: C enum (unsigned int encoding), no fields, no pointers, no lifecycle: a plain value copied by value. Public struct fields (AVFrame, AVCodecParameters, AVCodecContext, AVFilmGrainParams, ...) store it and users write them directly, so any c_uint is observed; AVCOL_PRI_NB / AVCOL_PRI_EXT_NB are 'not part of ABI'. C initialisers (av_frame_alloc's get_frame_defaults, avcodec_parameters_alloc) write AVCOL_PRI_UNSPECIFIED (2), not zero. Wrapped as the open newtype ffmpeg::libavutil::pixfmt::ColorPrimaries (CPlainElem).

types.name: AVColorPrimariesDesc
types._comment_agent: formats wave-3 batch-0 (wrap): a white point (wp, AVWhitepointCoefficients = AVCIExy) and the gamut's primaries (prim, AVPrimaryCoefficients), both embedded by value: 64 bytes of AVRationals, no pointer fields, no allocator, disposer or cloner anywhere in the public API. C's only producer is av_csp_primaries_desc_from_id, a const pointer into csp.c's static const color_primaries / color_primaries_ext tables (a 'static shared borrow, never written; NULL for entries with prim.r.x.num == 0), and its only libavutil reader is av_csp_primaries_id_from_desc (borrows a const pointer for the call, reads every coordinate). Other consumers (libswscale csputils/format/cms, libavfilter vf_colorspace, libavcodec png and dovi_rpu, fflcms2 out-parameter) read fields or copy the struct by value; AVDOVIDmLevel9/10 embed it by value. All-zero is valid (the tables' unspecified entries). Wrapped as a value type ColorPrimariesDescriptor with CieXyRef/CieXyMut and PrimaryCoefficientsRef/Mut handles over the projected fields.

types.name: AVColorRange
types._comment_agent: C enum (unsigned int encoding), no fields, no pointers, no lifecycle: a plain value copied by value. Public struct fields (AVFrame, AVCodecContext, AVCodecParameters, AVFilterLink, AVBufferSrcParameters, ...) store it and users write them directly, so any c_uint is observed; AVCOL_RANGE_NB is 'not part of ABI'. Zero is AVCOL_RANGE_UNSPECIFIED, which C initialisers also write. Wrapped as the open newtype ffmpeg::libavutil::pixfmt::ColorRange (CPlainElem).

types.name: AVColorSpace
types._comment_agent: Field-less C enum (libavutil/pixfmt.h), c_uint underlying (all enumerators non-negative). No pointers, no lifecycle: a plain value. Stored by value in public struct fields C users write directly (AVFrame.colorspace, AVCodecContext.colorspace, AVCodecParameters.color_space, ...) and passed by value to av_color_space_name / av_csp_luma_coeffs_from_avcsp, which bounds-check with (unsigned)csp < AVCOL_SPC_NB, so any int is a value C may hold and observe. AVCOL_SPC_YCOCG aliases AVCOL_SPC_YCGCO; AVCOL_SPC_NB is not part of the ABI. Wrapped as an open #[repr(transparent)] newtype (ColorSpace) accepting every bit pattern; Default is UNSPECIFIED, the value get_frame_defaults and the codec options set.

types.name: AVColorTransferCharacteristic
types._comment_agent: Field-less C enum (libavutil/pixfmt.h), c_uint underlying (all enumerators non-negative). No pointers, no lifecycle: a plain value. Stored by value in public struct fields C users write directly (AVFrame.color_trc, AVCodecContext.color_trc, AVCodecParameters.color_trc, ...) and passed by value to av_color_transfer_name and the av_csp_* trc/eotf lookups, which accept ISO/IEC 23091-2 values below AVCOL_TRC_NB and FFmpeg extensions in [AVCOL_TRC_EXT_BASE, AVCOL_TRC_EXT_NB), returning NULL/0 otherwise, so any int is a value C may hold and observe. AVCOL_TRC_SMPTEST2084 and AVCOL_TRC_SMPTEST428_1 are aliases, AVCOL_TRC_V_LOG equals AVCOL_TRC_EXT_BASE; AVCOL_TRC_NB and AVCOL_TRC_EXT_NB are not part of the ABI. Wrapped as an open #[repr(transparent)] newtype (ColorTransfer) accepting every bit pattern; Default is UNSPECIFIED, the value get_frame_defaults and the codec options set.

types.name: AVComponentDescriptor
types._comment_agent: Plain by-value struct of five ints (plane, step, offset, shift, depth); no pointer fields, no heap lifecycle. C never allocates, frees, clones or constructs one on its own: it lives embedded by value as AVPixFmtDescriptor.comp[4] in the static const av_pix_fmt_descriptors table (reached through av_pix_fmt_desc_get / av_pix_fmt_desc_next as a const pointer) and is copied by value by its readers (av_read_image_line2 copies desc->comp[c]; av_get_padded_bits_per_pixel, av_pix_fmt_count_planes, av_get_bits_per_pixel, imgutils, swscale and filters read the fields). Unused components (c >= nb_components) and hwaccel formats are all-zero, and av_read_image_line2 returns early on depth 0, so all-zero is a valid value. Values are not range-checked: C's own table stores offset = -1 for the big-endian 16-bit packed RGB formats (RGB565BE/RGB555BE/RGB444BE and BGR twins), plane is 0..3, step up to 32, shift up to 7, depth up to 32. Wrapped as the ffibox layout type ComponentDescriptor (CZeroable, Copy, Send + Sync as plain data) with ComponentDescriptorRef getters and ComponentDescriptorMut setters for all five fields.

types.name: AVDES
types._comment_agent: des.h publishes resource-free scalar triple_des and uint64_t[3][16] round_keys. des.c allocator av_des_alloc uses av_mallocz; contexts are also stack-allocated in tests and freed by av_free/av_freep in libavformat. av_des_init reads exactly 8 or 24 key bytes and retains nothing. Only active key rows are initialized by init; safe wrapper zeroes every row first. Any integer flag and round keys remain memory-safe; no cloner, refcount, lock, disposer, or pointer field.

types.name: AVDictionary
types._comment_agent: Opaque outside dict.c: public code holds AVDictionary only as a pointer, NULL meaning the empty dictionary everywhere (av_dict_count/get/iterate/copy/get_string accept NULL). No constructor or init routine: a dictionary comes into being when av_dict_set (also av_dict_parse_string and av_dict_copy, through it) inserts into a NULL *pm, and av_dict_set frees it and NULLs *pm when its last entry goes, so mutation needs the AVDictionary ** slot. Releaser: av_dict_free(&p) (NULL-safe, NULLs the slot). Deep copy: av_dict_copy(&dst = NULL, src, AV_DICT_MULTIKEY) appends every entry in order, duplicates included (flags 0 would collapse case-insensitive duplicate keys); on failure dst holds a partial copy the caller frees. No refcount, lock or thread affinity: storage is av_malloc'd and the const-taking readers never write. Rust (options wave 0): define_ctype!(Dictionary) opaque, DictionaryFree = av_dict_free + av_dict_copy(MULTIKEY), DictionaryBox = CBox<Dictionary, DictionaryFree> for a non-empty dictionary, and Dict = Option<DictionaryBox> for C's nullable slot.

ptr.note: The dictionary's `count` inline AVDictionaryEntry values, grown one slot at a time by av_realloc_array in av_dict_set and freed (with every entry's key and value) by av_dict_free, or by av_dict_set when the last entry is deleted, via av_freep. NULL only inside av_dict_set for a fresh av_mallocz'd struct before its first entry lands: every dictionary C hands out has count >= 1 and a non-NULL elems, because av_dict_set frees the struct and NULLs *pm whenever count drops to 0. Entries are written by av_dict_set only (append, swap-with-last on replace/delete, APPEND realloc of a value); av_dict_iterate/av_dict_get hand out pointers into the array, which any av_dict_set invalidates. The struct body is private to dict.c, so no public consumer reaches this field; the Rust wrapper keeps AVDictionary opaque.

types.name: AVDictionaryEntry
types._comment_agent: A plain {key, value} pair of owned strings that lives only inside an AVDictionary's elems array. It has no lifecycle routine of its own: entries are created, replaced and freed by av_dict_set and av_dict_free on the containing dictionary, and handed out (const or not) by av_dict_iterate/av_dict_get as pointers into the array that the next av_dict_set invalidates. Rust (options wave 0): define_ctype!(DictionaryEntry), borrowed only, key()/value() -> &'a CStr on DictionaryEntryRef; DictionaryEntryMut gets no setters because C forbids writing entries.

ptr.note: NUL-terminated key, an av_strdup copy (or the caller's av_malloc'd string under AV_DICT_DONT_STRDUP_KEY), owned by the dictionary that holds the entry and freed by av_dict_free (av_freep) or av_dict_set on replace/delete (av_free). av_dict_set stores an entry only when copy_key is non-NULL, so it is never NULL in a dictionary. Nothing writes through it after insertion; dict.h forbids callers to change it. An entry exists only inside a dictionary's elems array (no public routine allocates, embeds or takes one by value), so the Rust getter borrows it for the handle's lifetime, which is tied to a shared borrow of the dictionary: any av_dict_set invalidates entry pointers and needs the exclusive slot.

NUL-terminated value, an av_strdup copy (or the caller's av_malloc'd string under AV_DICT_DONT_STRDUP_VAL), owned by the dictionary and freed with the entry as for key. Never NULL in a dictionary: a NULL value passed to av_dict_set deletes instead of inserting. C writes through it only inside av_dict_set under AV_DICT_APPEND (av_realloc the old value, memcpy the new part after it), so it is mutable from dict.c; dict.h forbids callers to change it, and the Rust handles expose it read-only with the lifetime of a shared borrow of the dictionary.

types.name: AVEscapeMode
types._comment_agent: Plain C enum, no fields, no lifecycle. Values flow Rust->C only: a by-value `mode` argument of av_escape (avstring.c:323) and av_bprint_escape (bprint.c:264); no struct field, return or out-parameter stores it, so C never hands one back. bprint.c:268-313 maps AUTO to BACKSLASH and treats any unknown value as BACKSLASH. Rust representation: closed Rust enum EscapeMode {Auto, Backslash, Quote, Xml} with an infallible conversion into ffi::AVEscapeMode; out-of-range modes are not representable (they only alias BACKSLASH).

types.name: AVExpr
types._comment_agent: Opaque outside eval.c (public eval.h only forward-declares it). A parsed expression is a tree of av_mallocz'd nodes; av_expr_parse av_reallocs the root into an AVExprRoot (cast to/from) holding two owned av_mallocz blocks, var[VARS] (st/ld registers, written by av_expr_eval) and prng_state[VARS]. Lifecycle: av_expr_parse (alloc constructor through AVExpr **) and av_expr_free (recursive dropper, NULL-tolerant); no clone. Constant names and function-name arrays are read only during parsing; const_index records the position, so av_expr_eval reads const_values[const_index] unchecked. Rust: CBox<Expr, ExprFree> (crustify/rust/ffmpeg/libavutil/eval.rs, options wave 0 batch 1).

ptr.note: Anonymous-union member valid only when type == e_func0: a libm builtin (sin, exp, ...) or eval.c's etime, chosen by parse_primary; program-lifetime code, never freed. Read by eval_expr only.

Union member valid only when type == e_func1: a copy of av_expr_parse's funcs1[i] for the matched func1_names[i]; the caller's function, which must stay callable while the expression is evaluated (code: in practice static). The funcs1 array itself is not retained. Called by eval_expr with av_expr_eval's opaque.
As func1, for type == e_func2 and funcs2/func2_names.

Each of the 3 slots is NULL or an owned child node av_mallocz'd by parse_primary/make_eval_expr and released recursively by av_expr_free; written only during parsing. Children are never shared between parents (the do-nothing '(' path hands the inner node up instead of linking it twice).

types.name: AVFrameSideDataType
types._comment_agent: Plain C enum (AV_FRAME_DATA_PANSCAN=0 .. AV_FRAME_DATA_DOWNMIX_MATRIX=37, contiguous, no count sentinel, no deprecated enumerators). No fields, no pointers, no lifecycle. Every enumerator is non-negative, so the underlying type is unsigned (ffi::AVFrameSideDataType is a c_uint newtype). Passed by value to the av_frame_side_data_* and av_frame_{new,get,remove}_side_data family and stored in the public, user-writable field AVFrameSideData.type (also libavcodec's internal SideDataMap.frame). Every C reader accepts any value: av_frame_side_data_desc/_name bounds-check `(unsigned)type < FF_ARRAY_ELEMS(sd_props)` and a NULL name (returning NULL otherwise), av_frame_side_data_get/remove compare for equality, and the add/clone paths treat a NULL descriptor as 'no props'. A Rust view of AVFrameSideData.type may therefore meet any unsigned value: the wrapper must be an open, layout-compatible newtype accepting every value (not a Rust enum), plain data (CPlainElem), Send+Sync as an integer. PANSCAN is the zeroed value; no value means 'no side data', so the wrapper has no Default.

types.name: AVHMAC
types._comment_agent: hmac.c private body is never published; public hmac.h is opaque. av_hmac_alloc constructs callbacks and owns one algorithm-specific hash allocation, but does not initialize hash state: keyed safe constructor also invokes av_hmac_init before returning. init copies short keys or hashes long keys into inline key[128]; init/update/final retain no caller buffer. Only av_hmac_free releases hash and parent, including alloc-before-key-init state. No clone, upref, lock, shared ownership, or inline public variant.

ptr.note: Static C algorithm callback selected together with hash/blocklen/hashlen; never owns code. Nonnull on successful alloc; zero only during failed construction. Not published by hmac.h and intentionally not exposed by opaque wrapper.

Algorithm-discriminated singleton: AVMD5, AVSHA, or AVSHA512 allocated by its av_*_alloc. Nonnull on successful av_hmac_alloc; null on construction failure only. Exclusive mutable hash state; av_hmac_free uses av_freep then frees parent; no clone.

Static C algorithm callback selected together with hash/blocklen/hashlen; never owns code. Nonnull on successful alloc; zero only during failed construction. Not published by hmac.h and intentionally not exposed by opaque wrapper.

Static C algorithm callback selected together with hash/blocklen/hashlen; never owns code. Nonnull on successful alloc; zero only during failed construction. Not published by hmac.h and intentionally not exposed by opaque wrapper.

types.name: AVHMACType
types._comment_agent: Resource-free enum. All six integer values select algorithms in av_hmac_alloc; other values return NULL. No storage lifecycle, fields, or retained pointers.

types.name: AVHashContext
types._comment_agent: Public API opaque. av_hash_alloc owns context plus child; requires separate av_hash_init before hashing. Safe constructor combines allocation/init, av_hash_freep releases both. Metadata independent of initialization/finalization; name points into static hashdesc. All field touchers are in hash.c; consumers allocate/init/use/free opaque pointers. No clone, refcount, inline dispose, or public field surface; C owns layout/storage. No Send/Sync assertion.

ptr.note: CRC32 borrows static av_crc_get_table(AV_CRC_32_IEEE_LE) storage; NULL for other algorithms. Generic tables have 257 or 1024 AVCRC elements (configuration-dependent) and are initialized through ff_thread_once before return, then read-only. Architecture-specific acceleration tables may be selected. Never freed.

Owned singleton: AVMD5, AVMurMur3, AVRIPEMD, AVSHA, or AVSHA512 selected by type. av_hash_alloc allocates it; av_hash_init/update/final mutate it; av_hash_freep av_freep frees it. NULL for CRC32 and ADLER32; no clone/retain/transfer path.

types.name: AVLumaCoefficients
types._comment_agent: formats wave-1 batch-1 (wrap): three AVRational values by value (cr, cg, cb), no pointer fields, no allocator, disposer or cloner. C's only producer is av_csp_luma_coeffs_from_avcsp, which returns a const pointer into the static const luma_coefficients[AVCOL_SPC_NB] table (a 'static shared borrow, never written) or NULL for out-of-range ids and all-zero entries (cr.num == 0). Consumers (libswscale/format.c, libavfilter colorspace/drawutils/tonemap) read fields or copy the struct by value. All-zero is valid (the table's unset entries). Wrapped as a value type with RationalRef/RationalMut handles over the projected fields.

types.name: AVMD5
types._comment_agent: Public header forward declaration only; body is private and scalar/inline-array only, no pointer fields or child resources. av_md5_alloc returns fresh zeroed av_mallocz storage or NULL, but hashing requires av_md5_init. All callers retain sole ownership or borrow through hash/hmac parents; av_free/av_freep releases the allocation, and no cloner/refcount/disposer exists. Update reads and copies input during the call, retains no pointer; final writes exactly 16 digest bytes and leaves a memory-valid state, with C-specific post-final semantics preserved. Opaque ffibox layout/Ref/Mut plus CBox policy allocate with actual C size, never sizeof the bindgen opaque marker; only exclusive handles write. No Send/Sync added, no private fields exposed.

types.name: AVMatrixEncoding
types._comment_agent: Plain C enum (NONE=0, DOLBY, DPLII, DPLIIX, DPLIIZ, DOLBYEX, DOLBYHEADPHONE=6, NB=7 count sentinel), no fields, no lifecycle. Every enumerator is non-negative, so the C compiler and bindgen give it an unsigned underlying type (ffi::AVMatrixEncoding is a c_uint newtype); a negative int written into its storage reads back as a large unsigned value, never as a negative one. Stored as a raw int: the payload of AV_FRAME_DATA_MATRIXENCODING frame side data (decoders write the enum into the side-data bytes), SwrContext's AV_OPT_TYPE_INT option matrix_encoding (default AV_MATRIX_ENCODING_NONE, range NONE..NB-1, named consts none/dolby/dplii), and taken by value by swr_build_matrix2. Readers of side data and option memory may see any value, so the Rust representation is a #[repr(transparent)] newtype MatrixEncoding over ffi::AVMatrixEncoding with associated constants, infallible raw conversions both ways, index() into 0..COUNT, Default = NONE (the zeroed value and the swr option default), and CPlainElem (every c_uint bit pattern valid). Corrected by the formats wave-0 review: the previous finding called the encoding c_int.

types.name: AVMediaType
types._comment_agent: Plain C enum (UNKNOWN=-1, VIDEO..ATTACHMENT=0..4, NB=5 count sentinel), no fields, no lifecycle. Stored by C in public struct fields (AVCodecParameters.codec_type, AVCodecContext.codec_type, AVCodec.type, AVCodecDescriptor.type, AVFilterPad/filter types), in a C-allocated array (AVDeviceInfo.media_types), returned (avcodec_get_type, av_buffersink_get_type, avfilter_pad_get_type) and taken by value (av_get_media_type_string, whose default case returns NULL for any other value). Users write public fields directly, so C memory may hold any int, NB included. Rust representation: #[repr(transparent)] newtype MediaType over ffi::AVMediaType with associated constants, infallible raw conversions both ways, and CPlainElem (every c_int bit pattern valid) so C arrays read as plain slices.

types.name: AVMurMur3
types._comment_agent: Public header forward declaration only; body is private and scalar/inline-array only, no pointer fields or child resources. av_murmur3_alloc returns fresh zeroed av_mallocz storage or NULL, but hashing requires av_murmur3_init/av_murmur3_init_seeded. All callers retain sole ownership or borrow through hash/hmac parents; av_free/av_freep releases the allocation, and no cloner/refcount/disposer exists. Update reads and copies input during the call, retains no pointer; final writes exactly 16 digest bytes and leaves a memory-valid state, with C-specific post-final semantics preserved. Opaque ffibox layout/Ref/Mut plus CBox policy allocate with actual C size, never sizeof the bindgen opaque marker; only exclusive handles write. No Send/Sync added, no private fields exposed.

types.name: AVOption
types._comment_agent: Every AVOption lives in a static const table (no C path writes or allocates one), reached through AVClass.option, av_opt_next, av_opt_find/av_opt_find2: a shared borrow with no lifecycle. default_val is a union discriminated by type: FLAG_ARRAY->arr; CONST, BOOL, FLAGS, INT, UINT, INT64, UINT64, DURATION, PIXEL_FMT, SAMPLE_FMT->i64; DOUBLE, FLOAT, RATIONAL->dbl; string-parsed types->str; q is never read.

ptr.note: Union member, read only when type has AV_OPT_TYPE_FLAG_ARRAY; points at a static const AVOptionArrayDef or is NULL (opt.c: opt_array_sep, av_opt_set_defaults2).
Union member, read only when type is STRING, COLOR, IMAGE_SIZE, VIDEO_RATE, BINARY, CHLAYOUT or DICT (av_opt_set_defaults2, av_opt_is_set_to_default); NULL means no default.
String literal in a static const option table; NULL when an option has no help text.
String literal in a static const option table; NULL only in the table's terminating entry, which av_opt_next never returns.
String literal in a static const option table; NULL when the option belongs to no unit.

types.name: AVOptionArrayDef
types._comment_agent: Plain static const descriptor reached through AVOption.default_val.arr of an array option (AV_OPT_TYPE_FLAG_ARRAY); no C routine allocates, copies or frees one. size_min/size_max bound element counts in opt_set_array and av_opt_set_array (size_max 0 = unlimited); sep 0 means ','; av_opt_set_defaults2 av_assert0s that sep is not alphanumeric or a backslash. Rust: OptionArrayDef layout with Ref/Mut handles, CZeroable (all-zero is no default, unlimited, comma), def settable only to a &'static CStr (crustify/rust/ffmpeg/libavutil/opt.rs).

ptr.note: Default value serialized with sep; NULL for none. Every definition is a static const table entry (iamf.c demixing_matrix_def, filter/codec option tables) and def a string literal; C never writes or frees it. Read by av_opt_set_defaults2 (opt_set_array), av_opt_is_set_to_default and log_default (av_opt_show2).

types.name: AVOptionRange
types._comment_agent: A range is always an element of an AVOptionRanges list: av_mallocz'd by av_opt_query_ranges_default or a class callback and released only by av_opt_freep_ranges as part of the list (no standalone constructor, copy or free). Rust wraps it as OptionRange with borrowed OptionRangeRef/OptionRangeMut handles reached through the list's owner; str gets a borrowed getter, an av_free-releasing replacement setter and an owning take, all with HeapString (av_free policy).

ptr.note: NULL or an av_malloc-family NUL-terminated string owned by the range: av_opt_freep_ranges av_freep's it before the range itself. av_opt_query_ranges_default leaves it NULL (av_mallocz); a class query_ranges callback may set it (no in-tree class does; the test fixture av_strdup's one). Declared const char *, so never written through; replaced only by storing a new owned pointer after freeing the old. No C reader besides the release (opt_list prints value_min/value_max only).

types.name: AVOptionRanges
types._comment_agent: Allocated by av_opt_query_ranges / av_opt_query_ranges_default (or an AVClass.query_ranges callback, none in tree) through an out-parameter, released by av_opt_freep_ranges. No dup routine. nb_ranges and nb_components bound the release loop, so no setter may change them or range.

ptr.note: av_mallocz'd array of nb_ranges * nb_components AVOptionRange pointers, laid out component-major (range[nb_ranges * component + index]). Each element is an owned av_mallocz'd AVOptionRange (its str an owned av_malloc string) or NULL; av_opt_freep_ranges av_freep's every element's str, the element, then the array, writing NULL into each slot. NULL only for an empty (zeroed) list.

types.name: AVOptionType
types._comment_agent: C enum with no pointer fields: the base types AV_OPT_TYPE_FLAGS..AV_OPT_TYPE_UINT (1..20) combinable with the AV_OPT_TYPE_FLAG_ARRAY bit (1<<16). Stored by value in AVOption.type (and opt_type_desc's index via TYPE_BASE); any unsigned value can reach C through a class's option table, so Rust wraps it as an open newtype OptionType over the binding.

types.name: AVPictureType
types._comment_agent: C enum (NONE=0, I, P, B, S, SI, SP, BI), no fields and no lifecycle. Stored as an int in public struct fields C users write directly (AVFrame.pict_type, AVCodecParserContext.pict_type, ...), so any int value may appear; av_get_picture_type_char maps unknown values to '?'. Wrapped as a transparent newtype PictureType accepting every value, with named associated constants.

types.name: AVPixFmtDescriptor
types._comment_agent: No lifecycle routine: descriptors live only in pixdesc.c's static const table (av_pix_fmt_desc_get / av_pix_fmt_desc_next return pointers into it, av_pix_fmt_desc_get_id maps them back by pointer arithmetic) or in caller storage built by value; nothing allocates, frees or clones one. comp[4] is embedded AVComponentDescriptor by value. C readers of a whole descriptor (av_get_bits_per_pixel, av_get_padded_bits_per_pixel, av_read_image_line2, av_write_image_line2) index comp[] by nb_components and plane and shift by log2_chroma_* and depth without range checks, so wrappers passing a Rust-built descriptor to them must validate those fields. Wrapped (formats wave 1 batch 2) as a value type PixelFormatDescriptor with Ref/Mut handles.

ptr.note: Comma-separated alternative names as a string literal in the static descriptor table (e.g. gray: "gray8,y8"); NULL for most entries. Read by get_pix_fmt_internal (av_get_pix_fmt) via av_match_name; never allocated, freed or written. Rust: Option<&CStr>, set only from a &'static CStr.

Every AVPixFmtDescriptor C hands out is an element of pixdesc.c's `static const av_pix_fmt_descriptors[AV_PIX_FMT_NB]`, whose `.name` is a string literal: never allocated, freed or written. Entries the designated initialisers skip are zero, so `name` is NULL there; av_pix_fmt_desc_next skips them on `!prev->name` and av_get_pix_fmt_name returns the NULL as is. No C path stores a non-literal name. Rust: Option<&CStr>, set only from a &'static CStr.

types.name: AVPixelFormat
types._comment_agent: C enum (int-based: AV_PIX_FMT_NONE = -1 .. AV_PIX_FMT_NB), no fields or pointers, no lifecycle: a plain value. Public C structs store it in fields users write directly (AVCodecContext.pix_fmt/sw_pix_fmt, AVHWFramesContext.format/sw_format, AVCodecParserContext.format as int, AVFrame.format as int) and in AV_PIX_FMT_NONE-terminated arrays (AVCodec.pix_fmts, AVHWFramesConstraints.valid_hw_formats/valid_sw_formats, av_hwframe_transfer_get_formats out-array freed with av_free); a newer libavutil may return values beyond this header's enumerators. C readers bounds-check before indexing (av_pix_fmt_desc_get: 0 <= fmt < AV_PIX_FMT_NB), so every int is a valid stored value. Wrapped as a repr(transparent) newtype accepting every value, with associated constants for the enumerators, the three in-enum aliases and the 104 native-endian AV_PIX_FMT_NE macro aliases; CPlainElem for C-allocated arrays.

types.name: AVPrimaryCoefficients
types._comment_agent: formats wave-2 batch-0 (wrap): three AVCIExy chromaticities by value (r, g, b), i.e. six AVRationals, no pointer fields, no allocator, disposer or cloner. Embedded by value as AVColorPrimariesDesc.prim; C's only producer is av_csp_primaries_desc_from_id, a const pointer into the static const color_primaries table (a 'static shared borrow, never written), and its only libavutil reader is av_csp_primaries_id_from_desc (sums the absolute av_sub_q deltas of every coordinate against each table entry). Consumers (libswscale, libavfilter colorspace/tonemap/vf_iccgen, libavcodec fflcms2) read fields or copy the struct by value. All-zero is valid (the table's unspecified entries, skipped on prim.r.x.num == 0). Wrapped as a value type with CieXyRef/CieXyMut handles over the projected fields.

types.name: AVRC4
types._comment_agent: rc4.c alloc returns av_mallocz(sizeof AVRC4), released with av_free/av_freep (asfcrypt.c and tests). No pointer fields, resources, disposer or C cloner. Public body supports inline storage (rtmpcrypt key_in/key_out); all integers/bytes are memory-safe including zero state because crypt truncates x/y to uint8_t. Init reads a borrowed nonempty key, stores no pointer, decrypt ignored. Safe wrappers provide ffibox layout handles, Heap sole owner, Copy inline and Heap av_memdup clone; every mutation exclusive, no Send/Sync asserted.

types.name: AVRIPEMD
types._comment_agent: Public header is opaque; ripemd.c private body owns no suballocations. Alloc av_mallocz actual sizeof AVRIPEMD, released with av_freep via hash.c av_hash_freep and av_free in tests. Full storage remains C allocated. Only supported init 128/160/256/320 publishes an initialized owner, with static transform. No known C cloner or disposer. Dedicated ffibox RipemdFree policy delegates existing Heap CDrop and does not provide generic allocation of the incomplete binding; no inline constructor or CZeroable; no Send/Sync asserted.

ptr.note: av_mallocz leaves NULL before initialization. Supported init bits install one static ripemd128/160/256/320_transform; update invokes it with the inline state[10] and 64-byte block only for the call. No callback cookie, retained data or ownership transfer. Invalid init bits change digest_len before returning EINVAL and must not become safe initialized state.

types.name: AVRational
types._comment_agent: Plain by-value pair of ints; no pointer fields, no heap lifecycle. C passes and returns it by value (av_mul_q, av_d2q, ...) and embeds it by value in public structs (AVCodecContext.time_base, AVStream.time_base, AVFrame.sample_aspect_ratio, ...), or in caller arrays terminated by {0,0} (av_find_nearest_q_idx, AVCodec.supported_framerates). Its only constructor is the header inline av_make_q (by value, so it has no pointer-return lifetime record); copying is a byte copy and no routine drops, disposes or clones it. 0/0 is a value C itself produces (zeroed contexts, av_cmp_q's INT_MIN case) and every reader tolerates, so all-zero is a valid value. Wrapped as the ffibox layout type Rational (CZeroable, Copy, Send + Sync as plain data) with RationalRef/RationalMut num/den accessors.

types.name: AVRefStructOpaque
types._comment_agent: C `union { void *nc; const void *c; }` (wavefront records it as kind=struct, the known union defect): one user pointer, passed BY VALUE to av_refstruct_alloc_ext_c / av_refstruct_pool_alloc_ext_c, stored in RefCount.opaque / AVRefStructPool.opaque and handed back unchanged to the user's free_cb/init_cb/reset_cb/free_entry_cb. libavutil never dereferences a user's opaque; refstruct.c reuses RefCount.opaque.nc internally as the pool back-pointer of an entry in use and as the free-list `next` link of an available entry (pool_return_entry, refstruct_pool_get_ext, refstruct_pool_uninit), and pool_reset_entry reads opaque.nc as the AVRefStructPool. Both members span the same 8 bytes and every bit pattern is valid for both, so either member reads what the other wrote; `_c` vs plain API pairs only differ in which member the caller fills. No lifecycle routine: the union owns nothing, is never allocated, copied or freed on its own; Rust wraps it as a Copy value type (RefStructOpaque) with getters/setters for both members.

ptr.note: The const view of the same pointer (`_c` constructors let the user pass a const opaque without casting). Same bytes as `nc`; never freed or dereferenced by libavutil; const-qualified, so never written through.

User cookie (av_refstruct_alloc_ext / pool_alloc_ext fill `.nc`): never freed by FFmpeg and never dereferenced by libavutil; the user keeps the referent alive for as long as the object/pool may call back. Its pointee type is erased and chosen by the user (libavcodec passes contexts, e.g. decode.c's progress pool, mpegpicture.c's pic pool; container_fifo.c its callbacks); whether it is written through is up to the user's callbacks, so `mutable` is undeterminable. Internally refstruct.c stores the owning AVRefStructPool* (entry in use) or the next RefCount* (free list, under pool->mutex) in RefCount.opaque.nc.

types.name: AVRefStructPool
types._comment_agent: Opaque in the public API (body private to refstruct.c; libavcodec headers only forward-declare it). The pool is itself a RefStruct object: av_refstruct_pool_alloc(_ext_c) allocates it with av_refstruct_alloc_ext(sizeof pool, 0, NULL, refstruct_pool_uninit) and sets its RefCount.free to pool_unref, so its PUBLIC reference count is the RefCount header in front of it (av_refstruct_ref/unref/replace/exclusive act on it; libavcodec shares pools across frame threads with av_refstruct_replace, pthread_frame.c:397, vp9.c:1911). The struct's own `refcount` field is NOT that count: it counts outstanding entries plus one for the header's references, and only the pool's last reference or last returned entry frees the struct (pool_unref / pool_return_entry -> pool_free). Lifecycle: constructed by av_refstruct_pool_alloc / av_refstruct_pool_alloc_ext_c (refcount 1); up-ref av_refstruct_ref / av_refstruct_ref_c / av_refstruct_replace; down-ref av_refstruct_pool_uninit (static inline = av_refstruct_unref(poolp)), whose last call runs refstruct_pool_uninit (marks uninited, frees the free list) and pool_unref. av_refstruct_exclusive(pool) is NOT a sole-owner proof: entries handed out by av_refstruct_pool_get keep a back-pointer to the pool (RefCount.opaque.nc) and touch its mutex/free list/uninited/refcount when returned, from any thread, without being counted in the header. Thread-safety: size/opaque/callbacks/flags are written once at construction; available_entries and uninited only under `mutex`; refcount atomically; so the pool is Send+Sync whenever its callbacks are thread-safe (the header's note).

ptr.note: Head of an intrusive singly linked free list of returned entries (RefCount headers, linked through RefCount.opaque.nc). Owned: refstruct_pool_uninit detaches the list and frees every entry with pool_free_entry (free_entry_cb + av_free); refstruct_pool_get_ext pops the head for reuse. Read and written only under `mutex`.
User function pointer set once at construction; called once by pool_free when the pool struct itself is freed (last pool reference and last outstanding entry gone).
User function pointer set once at construction; called by pool_free_entry when an entry is freed after the pool was uninited, and on init failure with FREE_ON_INIT_ERROR.

User function pointer set once by av_refstruct_pool_alloc_ext_c (NULL from av_refstruct_pool_alloc); called by refstruct_pool_get_ext on a fresh entry outside the mutex, possibly concurrently from several threads.

User function pointer set once at construction; called through pool_reset_entry (the entry's free_cb) when an entry's last reference drops, on the unref'ing thread, and on init failure with RESET_ON_INIT_ERROR.

types.name: AVRegionOfInterest
types._comment_agent: Plain by-value struct (uint32_t self_size; int top, bottom, left, right; AVRational qoffset), no pointer field and no lifecycle routine of its own. It never stands alone in C: it is the element of AV_FRAME_DATA_REGIONS_OF_INTEREST side data, an array whose element count is the payload size over the first element's self_size and whose stride is self_size; frame.h requires self_size == sizeof(AVRegionOfInterest) (vf_addroi writes that). Readers (vf_showinfo dump_roi, vf_addroi, libx264, libx265, libvpxenc, vaapi_encode, qsvenc, d3d12va_encode) check only self_size != 0 and size % self_size == 0, then read a whole 28-byte struct at every stride: a nonzero self_size below sizeof passes and reads past the payload (ASan heap-buffer-overflow in vf_showinfo.c:151 and vf_addroi.c:139 for self_size 4 on a 28-byte payload; review buffer-frame wave-1 batch-0, misc/region-of-interest-self-size-hazards). self_size == 0 is an error in most readers but vf_addroi aborts the process (av_assert0, vf_addroi.c:119). qoffset is not range-checked: encoders refuse den == 0 only; d3d12va_encode.c:239 computes num * qp_range / den in int (overflow) and libvpxenc.c:1610 converts num/den*MAX_DELTA_Q to int unchecked, so values outside [-1, 1] can be C UB there. Nothing allocates, frees or copies one except as side-data bytes, so all-zero is a valid Rust value; but any safe wrapper that hands a REGIONS_OF_INTEREST payload to C (side data stores, filters, encoders) must check every element's self_size == sizeof (and the qoffset range for the encoders above) first. No field is range-checked by libavutil. Wrapped (buffer-frame wave 1 batch 0) as the ffibox value type RegionOfInterest (CZeroable, Copy, Send + Sync as plain data): RegionOfInterest::new and Default set self_size to sizeof; RegionOfInterestRef getters for every field (qoffset as a RationalRef over the projected place), RegionOfInterestMut setters, qoffset_mut and whole-value set/get.

types.name: AVRounding
types._comment_agent: By-value only: AVRounding is never stored in a field, returned, or passed to a callback; it flows Rust->C as the `rnd` argument of av_rescale_rnd / av_rescale_q_rnd (and libswscale's static ops helper). av_rescale_rnd accepts a method in {0,1,2,3,5}, alone or ORed with AV_ROUND_PASS_MINMAX (8192); any other value returns INT64_MIN (av_assert2 is compiled out: ASSERT_LEVEL is undefined in every campaign build). types.name: AVSHA
types._comment_agent: Public forward declaration only. C owns concrete layout/allocation. av_sha_alloc is av_mallocz(sizeof AVSHA); successful av_sha_init (160/224/256) establishes transform and resets count; reinit may change algorithm and leaves stale buffer bytes unread until filled. Hash/HMAC/Mov owners free through av_free/av_freep; random_seed uses adequately sized aligned inline scratch and init. No refcount, heap fields, retained input, clone, or field disposer. Safe wrapper exposes full-sized allocated initialized owners and borrowed handles; no public field access.

ptr.note: Zero-filled allocation has NULL before init. Successful init stores sha1_transform or sha256_transform, static functions with no ownership or freeing; update invokes it on context state (5 or 8 u32 words) and a 64-byte read-only block. Not public; callers cannot set or invoke it independently.

types.name: AVSHA512
types._comment_agent: Public forward declaration only; all fields are by-value integers/arrays private to sha512.c. av_sha512_alloc calls av_mallocz(sizeof AVSHA512), successful init (224/256/384/512) sets state/digest_len and count=0. C hash/HMAC owners release through av_freep; no refcount, heap fields, retained input, clone or field disposer. Reinit leaves stale buffer bytes which update overwrites before reading. Safe wrapper only uses full-sized initialized C allocations behind ffibox handles.

types.name: AVSampleFormat
types._comment_agent: C enum (int-backed, AV_SAMPLE_FMT_NONE = -1 .. AV_SAMPLE_FMT_NB = 12): no fields, no pointers, no lifecycle. Stored by value in public fields users write directly (AVCodecContext.sample_fmt / request_sample_fmt, AVFrame.format as int, AVOption AV_OPT_TYPE_SAMPLE_FMT targets) and in AV_SAMPLE_FMT_NONE-terminated arrays (AVCodec.sample_fmts), so any int is an observable value; libavutil/samplefmt.c and swresample bound-check with `< 0 || >= AV_SAMPLE_FMT_NB` before table lookups. Wrapped as an open #[repr(transparent)] newtype (SampleFormat) accepting every int; plain element (CPlainElem) for av_malloc arrays.

types.name: AVSideDataDescriptor
types._comment_agent: No lifecycle routine: descriptors live only in side_data.c's static const sd_props[] table, indexed by AVFrameSideDataType; av_frame_side_data_desc returns a const pointer into it (NULL for out-of-range types and for gaps whose name is NULL), and av_frame_side_data_name reads desc->name. Nothing allocates, frees, clones or writes one; callers can also build one by value. props is an unsigned set of AVSideDataProps bits read by av_frame_side_data_new/add/clone (MULTI), av_frame_side_data_remove_by_props (any bit) and fftools ifilter_parameters_from_frame (GLOBAL); no bit is range-checked. Wrapped (buffer-frame wave 0 batch 4) as a value type SideDataDescriptor (CZeroable, Copy, Send + Sync as plain data with 'static strings) with SideDataDescriptorRef getters and SideDataDescriptorMut setters; props as SideDataProps, a Copy newtype over the raw enum.

Every entry av_frame_side_data_desc returns has a non-NULL name (it returns NULL for table gaps instead); an all-zero or caller-built descriptor may hold NULL. Never allocated, freed or written. Rust: Option<&'static CStr>, set only from a &'static CStr.

types.name: AVSideDataProps
types._comment_agent: Flag enum (bits 0..4: GLOBAL, MULTI, SIZE_DEPENDENT, COLOR_DEPENDENT, CHANNEL_DEPENDENT); never stored as the enum type: C keeps combinations in AVSideDataDescriptor.props (unsigned) and passes them as int to av_frame_side_data_remove_by_props, filters OR them into an int. Any bit pattern is a valid value. No lifecycle. Wrapped (buffer-frame wave 0 batch 4) as SideDataProps, a Copy bitflags-style newtype over the raw ffi::AVSideDataProps (c_uint) keeping unnamed bits.

types.name: AVTEA
types._comment_agent: AVTEA is opaque in its public header; all fields are inline integers/arrays, no pointer fields, resources, clone routine, retain or transfer. av_tea_alloc uses av_mallocz, the caller owns it and av_free/av_freep releases it. Init copies key bytes and retains no argument pointer. Crypt reads the initialized schedule only. C remains layout/storage owner; no public fields and no field accessors.

types.name: AVTWOFISH
types._comment_agent: AVTWOFISH is opaque in its public header; all fields are inline integers/arrays, no pointer fields, resources, clone routine, retain or transfer. av_twofish_alloc uses av_mallocz, the caller owns it and av_free/av_freep releases it. Init copies key bytes and retains no argument pointer. Crypt reads the initialized schedule only. C remains layout/storage owner; no public fields and no field accessors.

types.name: AVXTEA
types._comment_agent: AVXTEA is sixteen inline uint32_t words, no pointer fields, casts, locks, refcounts or field resources. av_xtea_alloc calls av_mallocz(sizeof(AVXTEA)); callers pair it with av_free. rtmpcrypt.c uses an automatic context. Both init routines copy a 16-byte key into ONLY words 0..4, preserving words 4..16; their key argument is omitted by extraction because it is an array parameter. All cipher readers index only 0..4, never modify or retain the context, and support zero words. Plain word copies are independent; no dedicated C clone/disposer. Safe inline values and Heap-owned CBox storage retain ABI; borrow handles exclude concurrent modification. No Send/Sync opt-in.

types.name: av_alias16
types._comment_agent: A union (the composer reports kind=struct for the anonymous typedef'd union) declared __attribute__((may_alias)) for type punning in the AV_RN/AV_WN/AV_COPY/AV_SWAP/AV_ZERO macros. Fields u16 and u8[2] are plain scalars that both cover all 2 bytes, so every bit pattern is valid for every field and reading any field of an initialised object is defined. No pointer fields, no allocation, no teardown, no clone routine: C only ever casts existing storage to av_alias16* (opaque_in footprint) or holds it by value. Lifecycle: none; a by-value, trivially copyable value type, all-zero valid.

types.name: av_alias32

Fields u32, u16[2], u8[4] and f32 are plain scalars that each cover all 4 bytes, so every bit pattern is valid for every field and reading any field of an initialised object is defined. No pointer fields, no allocation, no teardown, no clone routine: C casts existing storage (Mv, VP8mv, VP9mv, byte buffers) to av_alias32* or holds it by value (exif.c). Lifecycle: none; a by-value, trivially copyable value type, all-zero valid.

types.name: av_alias64
types._comment_agent: Plain-data type-punning union (u64 / u32[2] / u16[4] / u8[8] / f64 / f32[2], 8 bytes, align 8, may_alias). No pointer fields, no refcount, no lock. No lifecycle routine exists: every C user holds it inline as a local or reaches it by casting a naturally aligned buffer pointer (AV_RNA/AV_WNA/AV_COPY/AV_SWAP/AV_ZERO in intreadwrite.h, aes_ctr.c, h264/vp8/vp9 predictors); nothing allocates, frees, clones or disposes it beyond a byte copy. Every member spans all 8 bytes and every bit pattern is valid for each, so all-zero is a valid value and any member may be read after any write. Wrapped as a Copy value type (Rust-owned inline storage) with by-value getters/setters per member.

types.name: av_intfloat32
types._comment_agent: Plain-data union { uint32_t i; float f; } (4 bytes) used only as a local to reinterpret bits (av_int2float / av_float2int, aac, sbrdsp, exr, vf_lut3d). No pointer fields, no refcount, no lock, no lifecycle routine; every bit pattern is valid for both members, so all-zero is valid and either member may be read after writing the other. Wrapped as a Copy value type with by-value getters/setters.

types.name: av_intfloat64
types._comment_agent: C `union av_intfloat64 { uint64_t i; double f; }` (the record's kind says struct; the definition is a union). A type-punning union: no discriminator, both members cover all 8 bytes and every bit pattern is a valid value of each, so either view is always readable after a write to the other (av_int2double writes i and reads f; av_double2int the reverse). No pointer fields, no sub-allocations and no lifecycle routine: C only creates it as an automatic local or a const initializer ({.i = ...} in libavcodec/mips/constants.c, mips-only); copied by value, never freed. All-zero is valid (i = 0, f = +0.0). No shared state or lock: plain data, Send/Sync like u64.

The authored BPrintFields value uses str only as a nullable borrowed immutable C string, with no relationship to len/size/size_max or reserved_internal_buffer. AVBPrint ownership belongs to the separate AVBPrint record, not this helper.

The independent scalar fields do not bound the string or imply allocation. Unlike AVBPrint this is not self-referential and is freely copyable.

types.name: unaligned_16
types._comment_agent: Packed (align 1), may_alias single-member union { uint16_t l; } declared only under __GNUC__/__clang__ (the composer records it as a struct). Field `l` is a by-value scalar: any bit pattern is valid, all-zero included, no lock guards it (callers synchronise the byte buffer they cast).

An initialised AVBPrint (av_bprint_init / av_bprint_init_for_buffer), borrowed mutably for the call only and not retained. When the text does not fit, av_bprint_alloc grows str only while size < size_max and the buffer is complete: an inline string is copied into a fresh av_realloc block the struct then owns, an owned block is av_realloc'd; a caller buffer (size == size_max) never grows. What does not fit is truncated, but len counts it (capped at UINT_MAX - 5); str stays NUL-terminated at min(len, size - 1). Appends min(size, room - 1) bytes of data with memcpy.

`size` bytes read with memcpy for the call only (binary, NULs included, not a string). Only min(size, room - 1) bytes are read, none when the buffer has no room; it must not alias the buffer's own storage, which av_realloc may move. The safe wrapper passes a Rust slice, split into UINT_MAX-byte pieces.

An initialised AVBPrint (av_bprint_init / av_bprint_init_for_buffer), borrowed mutably for the call only and not retained.
